scripts.package:mac: npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:mac:release && node scripts/stage-macos-download.mjs
scripts.package:mac:dev: npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:mac && npm --prefix apps/desktop run audit:distribution-ip
scripts.package:win: npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:win && node scripts/stage-windows-download.mjs
scripts.package:all: npm run package:mac && npm run package:win
scripts.lint: npm run lint:site && npm run lint:desktop
scripts.lint:site: eslint 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx}' next.config.ts eslint.config.mjs && npm run lint:migrations
scripts.lint:desktop: eslint apps/desktop/electron/main.cjs apps/desktop/electron/openclaw.cjs apps/desktop/electron/preload.cjs apps/desktop/electron/tools.cjs apps/desktop/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
